detail.longDescription: 🚀 New release: Grundschutz OSCAL Viewer We’re excited to announce a new release of Grundschutz OSCAL Viewer — an open-source tool for working with BSI IT-Grundschutz OSCAL content. Designed for security and compliance workflows around BSI Grundschutz and NIS2. 🦀 Built with Rust 🐧 Linux 🍎 macOS 🔗 https:// crates.io/crates/grundschutz-o scal-viewer # ndaal # Rust # opensource # Grundschutz # BSI # NIS2 # Linux # macOS
